curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: identify words with the sounds /b/, /r/ /u/ and /g/, and their corresponding letters for reading competence

mission.title: Sound Scouts: b, r, u and g

interactions.prompt: Listen for /b/. Which word begins with that sound?
interactions.feedback: Yes! Bag begins with /b/ and the letter b.
interactions.retryHint: Close your lips, then release them: /b/, bag.

interactions.prompt: Which letter begins the word rug?
interactions.feedback: Right! Rug begins with /r/ and r.

interactions.prompt: Sort each word by its first sound.
interactions.feedback: Great listening! Each word is beside its first sound.
interactions.retryHint: Say each word slowly and listen only to the beginning.

interactions.prompt: Pick the two words that begin with /g/.
interactions.feedback: Correct! Girl and goat both begin with g, /g/.

interactions.prompt: Match each word to its first letter.
interactions.feedback: Wonderful! You matched every sound to its letter.
interactions.retryHint: Say the word, hold its first sound, then find the letter.

interactions.feedback: Excellent! r plus un makes run.
interactions.retryHint: Say run and listen for /r/ at the start.
